svg.title: Butcher — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as butcher, wearing an apron and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A wide rectangular cleaver and its separate narrow handle sit above a sturdy chopping block. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
